label: doc_capacity_metrics_dax_name_error
description: Built from the documented schema, not recorded live: executeQueries answers HTTP 400 when the DAX names a measure the model no longer has (the app was updated). The body shape (error.pbi.error.details) is the one Microsoft's error handling is known for; the wording of the message is an assumption.

queries.query:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    21000,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'TimePoints'[TimePoint],
        TREATAS({"00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a0"}, 'Capacities'[capacityId]),
        FILTER(ALL('TimePoints'[TimePoint]), 'TimePoints'[TimePoint] >= (DATE(2026, 10, 21) + TIME(12, 0, 0)) && 'TimePoints'[TimePoint] <= (DATE(2026, 10, 21) + TIME(12, 30, 0))),
        "CuPercent", [CU %],
        "InteractiveDelayPercent", [Interactive delay %],
        "BackgroundRejectionPercent", [Background rejection %]
    ),
    'TimePoints'[TimePoint], DESC
)
ORDER BY 'TimePoints'[TimePoint] ASC

detail.value: Query (11, 9) Failed to resolve name 'Interactive delay %'. It is not a valid table, variable, or function name.
